11 March 2022

## Circular to licensed corporations

## SFC-HKMA joint product survey 2021: extension of submission deadline

In light of the latest COVID-19 situation, we understand that licensed corporations may need more time to complete the survey 1 . Accordingly, the deadline for submitting the survey questionnaire has been extended from 11 March 2022 to 19 April 2022 .

Should you have any queries regarding the contents of this circular, please contact Ms Michelle Mak at the Intermediaries Supervision Department of the SFC at 2231 1707 or your case officer.

Intermediaries Supervision Department Intermediaries Division Securities and Futures Commission

End

SFO/IS/017/2022

1  Please refer to the Circular to intermediaries - SFC-HKMA joint product survey 2021 issued on 10 December 2021 for information about the survey and the reporting timetable.
